title: Temperature excursions
purpose: Track the times a tank or freezer went outside the limits your repository set, from first record through review and closure.
summary: The times a tank or freezer went outside the limits your repository set, from first record through review and closure.

tasks.title: Find excursions to review
steps: Managers and administrators: open [[More filters]], tick [[Awaiting my review]] and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Check whether a specimen was affected
steps: Type its ID in [[Affected specimen]] under More filters.

good_to_know: Affected specimen searches closed excursions only, whose specimen list is captured at closing.
You never review an excursion you submitted.
Holds are placed and released on specimens, not by the excursion's status.

sections.title: What the page shows
paragraphs: Each row is one excursion (numbered EX-000001 and up). An excursion is recorded by people; nothing opens one automatically when a reading is outside the limits. It moves from Open to Awaiting review to Closed, and a closed one can be reopened. Excursions are never deleted.
Every role that can sign in to the workspace can read this list, including viewers.

Type in the search box to narrow the rows, use the filters beside it, and choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page (the default is 25). Active filters appear as chips that you can remove one by one, and the sort and column choices are kept in the address, so a view can be shared. A filter value that is not valid shows no rows rather than all of them. Changing a filter returns you to the first page.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches the excursion number (EX-000012, EX12 or 12) or part of the asset ID or equipment name. The default sort is Started, newest first. Sortable columns are Excursion, Status, Equipment, Started, Ended and Extreme (°C).

items.label: Status
items.description: Any status (the default), Open or awaiting review, Open, Awaiting review or Closed.

items.label: Cause
items.description: Any cause, or one cause category.

items.label: Awaiting my review
items.description: Under the More control, for managers and administrators only. Excursions awaiting review that somebody else submitted, which you can close.

items.label: Affected specimen
items.description: Under the More control. A specimen ID; lists closed excursions whose captured specimen list includes it. Open excursions are not searched because their list is computed on their own page.

items.label: From, To
items.description: Under the More control. Excursions that started on or after the first date and on or before the second.

items.label: Excursion
items.description: The number; opens the excursion. Always shown.

items.label: Storage unit
items.description: The unit the equipment enclosed when the excursion was opened.

items.label: Started, Ended
items.description: Times. While there is no end time, Ended shows a running grey clock with how long the excursion has been going on.

items.label: Extreme (°C)
items.description: The extreme temperature recorded, if any, in red, with the storage unit's nominal temperature muted beside it.

items.label: New excursion
items.description: Technicians, managers and administrators. Opens the form.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads the rows that match the current search, filters and sort as a UTF-8 CSV file, with exact decimal values and times in the repository's time zone. Every role that can read the list can download it. Correct any invalid filters to enable the download. If more than 10,000 rows match, the page shows the row limit. Narrow the filters to export. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe. Each download is recorded in the audit trail with who exported which selection and how many rows, never the file itself.

items.label: No temperature excursions recorded
items.description: None has been recorded. Technicians and above see a New excursion button.
